user_problem: Retry documentation mentions idempotency keys but leaves duplicate, mismatch, expiry, and concurrency behavior unclear.
unique_output: A behavior matrix for first requests, exact replays, payload mismatches, concurrent duplicates, and expired keys.
required_input: Key scope, retention duration, response-replay rule, payload comparison rule, and documented error outcomes.
critical_rule: Never assume retries are safe; any undocumented matrix cell must remain an explicit contract question.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is retry-budget-audit; this specifies duplicate-request semantics rather than evaluating retry limits.
acceptance_scenario: Input keys are scoped per account for 24 hours; exact replay returns original response; changed payload returns 409. Output fills those cases and marks concurrent duplicate handling and post-expiry behavior unspecified.
